Select distinct compound ChEMBL IDs aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES aliased as canonical_smiles for compounds tested in assays against the JAK2 target in human organisms. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to match JAK2 and assays.assay_organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Deduplicate on compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
